lines.en: label yukicamp2:
scene yukiwater1
There’s some sort of riverbank or something along those lines that runs through the campsite.
lines.zh: 营地里流淌着一条类似河岸还是什么的水道。

lines.en: And, after following it for several minutes out of sheer boredom or despondence or the inability to currently spend time with my niece, I wind up at a clearing made less clear by the inclusion of Yuki.
lines.zh: 而我，纯粹出于无聊，或者沮丧，或者只是因为此刻没法陪我侄女，沿着它走了几分钟，最后来到一片空地——而 Yuki 的存在让这片空地不那么空了。

lines.en: Which isn’t to say she’s an unwelcome contaminant despite the fact that her blood is the least drinkable of everyone’s here. Probably.
lines.zh: 这并不是说她是不受欢迎的污染物，尽管在场的每个人里，她的血大概是最难喝的。大概吧。

lines.en: I don’t know much about cannibalism, but I do know that she’d be the last one among us I’d be willing to eat and it wouldn’t be due to the way I feel about her.
lines.zh: 我不太懂吃人这回事，但我知道，她会是我们之中我最不愿意去吃的那个，而这跟我怎么看待她无关。

lines.en: But how even {i}do{/i} I feel about her?
lines.zh: 可我{i}到底是{/i}怎么看待她的？

lines.en: I like her enough to not cannibalize her. That much is true.
lines.zh: 我喜欢她到不愿意吃她。这点是真的。

lines.en: But does that “like” extend beyond the reaches of Armin Meiwes and into a basket you could strap to a bicycle on a long ride through Rotenburg?
lines.zh: 但这份「喜欢」有没有延伸到 Armin Meiwes 的领域之外，延伸到一只能绑在自行车上、一路骑过 Rotenburg 的篮子里？

lines.en: The implied proposal here is meant to isolate each trace of carnality and force you into an escapable (yet entirely metaphorical) line at your local department of motor vehicles or grocery store or something of the like.
lines.zh: 这个隐晦的求婚，意在把每一丝肉欲都单独剥离出来，然后把你推进一条可以逃出去（却完全是隐喻性的）队伍里——在你当地的车管所、杂货店，或者类似的地方。

lines.en: Anywhere you could go reluctantly before finding yourself in a row full of other somewhat depressed and dejected people while thinking to yourself, “I’m in too deep now” or “If I leave, I’ll look awkward or weak.”
lines.zh: 任何你会不情不愿地走进去，然后发现自己夹在一排同样有点消沉沮丧的人中间，一边心里想着「我已经陷得太深了」或者「我要是走了，会显得很尴尬、很软弱」的地方。

lines.en: I think that not knowing how you feel about someone is a lot like finding yourself in one of those places. Or finding yourself hovering over the corpse of one who has agreed to be eaten.
lines.zh: 我觉得，搞不清自己对某个人是什么感觉，很像发现自己身处那种地方。或者像发现自己正悬在一具同意被吃掉的尸体上方。

lines.en: I think I’d allow Yuki to eat me if she really wanted to.
lines.zh: 我想，如果 Yuki 真的想吃掉我，我会让她吃。

lines.en: She probably doesn’t, but I think I would let her. And I think I would let her because I think it’d be what I deserve.
lines.zh: 她大概不想，但我想我会让她。而我想我会让她，是因为我觉得那是我应得的。

lines.en: But love and like are more than just bleeding out into a bathtub, right? Love and like and lovely and likely. But they’re also hateful in the fact that I’d hate to ever love or like love or like.
lines.zh: 可爱与喜欢，远不止是在浴缸里流血至死，对吧？爱、喜欢、可爱、可能。但它们也可恨——可恨在我会恨自己去爱、去喜欢爱、去喜欢。

lines.en: In the midst of this half-hearted delusion or doubt or whatever you want to call it, my mind takes a dip in the river — but my heart is in Rotenburg.
lines.zh: 在这场半心半意的妄想、或者怀疑、或者随便你怎么称呼它的东西之中，我的头脑在河里浸了一下——但我的心在 Rotenburg。

lines.en: And so is every other piece of me.
lines.zh: 而我身上其余的每一块，也都在那儿。

lines.en: If anyone is reading this or hearing this or watching this or whatever it is you’re supposed to be doing or think that you’re doing or are only doing because I think you’re supposed to hear or read or listen, know this.
lines.zh: 如果有人正在读这个、听这个、看这个，或者不管你该做什么、以为自己在做什么、又或者只是因为我觉得你该听见或读到或聆听才在做——请记住这一点。

lines.en: I’m not very fond of bugs.
lines.zh: 我不太喜欢虫子。

lines.en: But I will never take pleasure in killing them.
lines.zh: 但我永远不会以杀死它们为乐。

lines.en: : Yuki.
lines.zh: : Yuki。

lines.en: scene yukiwater2
: Hm?
: The fuck you doin’ over there? Just standin’ around and watching me like that makes you look like some kind of stalker.
lines.zh: : 你他妈在那边干嘛？就那么站着盯着我，看着像个跟踪狂。

lines.en: : I didn’t know what else to do.
lines.zh: : 我不知道还能做什么。

lines.en: : Don’t wanna hang out with any of the others? Figured you were way closer to them than you are to me.
lines.zh: : 不想跟其他人待一起？我以为你跟他们比跟我亲近多了。

lines.en: : Is that why {i}you’re{/i} alone? You feel like you don’t fit in?
lines.zh: : 这就是{i}你{/i}一个人的原因？你觉得格格不入？

lines.en: scene yukiwater3
: Nah. It ain’t anything that dramatic. Just trying to relax a little.
lines.zh: : 不。没那么夸张。只是想放松一下。

lines.en: : I ain’t got a lot of experience with camping and shit, but I ain’t no stranger to sleepin’ outside. Shit like that was actually pretty normal back when I was younger.
lines.zh: : 我露营什么的没什么经验，但我对睡在外面可不陌生。我年轻的时候，那种事其实挺平常的。

lines.en: : But hey, when you ain’t got a place to live, you make do with what you’ve got.
lines.zh: : 不过嘿，当你没有地方住的时候，就只能将就着用手头有的东西。

lines.en: : And sometimes, all you’ve got is a bench in some town you can’t even remember the name of and a bunch of other girls drinking and laughing while you just want to sleep.
lines.zh: : 而有时候，你全部拥有的，只是某个你连名字都记不起来的镇子上的一张长椅，还有一群喝着酒大笑的女孩，而你只想睡觉。

lines.en: : Do you ever miss it? Being wild and free?
lines.zh: : 你会怀念吗？那种野蛮又自由的日子？

lines.en: : Miss when my knees didn’t hurt. And when I wasn’t so fuckin’ tired all the time.
lines.zh: : 怀念我膝盖不疼的时候。还有不那么他妈整天累的时候。

lines.en: : And yeah, maybe I {i}do{/i} miss the “freedom” part a little. But what I’ve got goin’ on now ain’t all that bad when you compare it to everything else I’ve lived through.
lines.zh: : 还有，是啊，也许我{i}确实{/i}有点怀念「自由」那部分。不过和我已经经历过的其他一切相比，我现在过的日子也不算太糟。

lines.en: : Everything apart from how your upbringing wasn’t ever terrible to begin with, right?
lines.zh: : 除了你的成长经历本来就不算糟糕这一点之外，对吧？

lines.en: scene yukiwater4
: You remember that, huh?
lines.zh: : 你还记得那个啊？

lines.en: : My memory’s pretty terrible, but there are certain things that’ll always stick out to me.
lines.zh: : 我的记性很差，但有些东西永远会从我记忆里凸出来。

lines.en: : Things like girls who grew up in candy stores?
lines.zh: : 比如在糖果店里长大的女孩之类的事？

lines.en: : Things like the minor details that have turned the people I like spending time with into people I like spending time with.
lines.zh: : 比如那些微小的细节——正是它们把那些我喜欢与之相处的人，变成了我喜欢与之相处的人。

lines.en: : Then tell me, what else do you remember about me?
lines.zh: : 那告诉我，你还记得我什么？

lines.en: : I remember how Yumi was made.
lines.zh: : 我记得 Yumi 是怎么来的。

lines.en: : Oh yeah? {i}You{/i} the one who came inside me when I was passed out? Answer carefully or I’ll be on your case for over a decade’s worth of child support.
lines.zh: : 哦是吗？那当年在我昏过去时射在我里面的人是{i}你{/i}？想清楚再回答，不然我会追着你讨十几年的抚养费。

lines.en: : That’s not what I was implying.
lines.zh: : 我不是那个意思。

lines.en: scene yukiwater5
: Then why the fuck did you word it like you were there watching the magic happen? You don’t know shit, man.
lines.zh: : 那你他妈干嘛说得好像你当时就在现场看着魔法发生一样？你他妈什么都不懂，老兄。

lines.en: : I wish I had a better answer for you, but even the words inside of my head are sewn together strangely at times.
lines.zh: : 我真希望能给你一个更好的回答，可连我脑子里的词句，有时都是被奇怪地缝在一起的。

lines.en: : Yeah, well you’re one of those {i}creative{/i} types, ain’t ya? Complete opposite of people like me who never stuck around to learn about proverbs or pronouns.
lines.zh: : 是嘛，你就是那种{i}创作型{/i}的家伙吧？跟我这种从来没留下来学过谚语或者代词的人完全相反。

lines.en: : On the bright side, you could beat me in a fight. So if the world breaks out into a war-zone, you’ll probably outlast me.
lines.zh: : 往好处想，打架你能赢我。所以要是世界爆发成战区，你大概比我活得久。

lines.en: : World’s already turned into a war-zone. But somehow, people like us have managed to avoid it.
lines.zh: : 世界早就变成战区了。可不知怎么，我们这种人躲过去了。

lines.en: : You’ve avoided it because you have a vagina. I’ve avoided it because I-
lines.zh: : 你躲过去是因为你有阴道。我躲过去是因为我——

lines.en: : Also have a vagina?
lines.zh: : 也有阴道？

lines.en: scene yukiwater6
: Sorry. Did I hurt your feelings?
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我伤到你感情了？

lines.en: : Yes. And I am ending our friendship as a result of this. Goodbye, Yuki.
lines.zh: : 是的。因此我现在宣布终结我们的友谊。再见，Yuki。

lines.en: : Damn, really? Oh well. Guess I’ll have to just empty out this entire cooler all by myself.
lines.zh: : 操，真的吗？好吧。那我只好自己把整个冷藏箱喝空了。

lines.en: : Are you apologizing in the form of giving me free alcohol?
lines.zh: : 你是在以免费给我酒的形式道歉吗？

lines.en: : Free? No way. I’m a bartender now. You tip me for this shit.
lines.zh: : 免费？想得美。我现在是调酒师了。这种东西你得给小费。

lines.en: : Unfortunately, I left all of my cash at home on account of convenience stores not existing in the woods.
lines.zh: : 不巧的是，我把所有现金都落家里了，毕竟树林里没有便利店。

lines.en: scene black
: I’ll just add it to your tab then. Been keepin’ a close eye on that shit since Sara’s always givin’ you booze for free.
lines.zh: : 那就记在你账上。我一直盯着那笔账呢，因为 Sara 老是免费给你酒喝。

lines.en: : I have a tab?
lines.zh: : 我有账？

lines.en: : Damn right. And I’m the type of girl who always {i}collects,{/i} if you know what I mean.
lines.zh: : 他妈的当然有。而且我是那种一定会{i}收账{/i}的女孩，如果你懂我意思的话。

lines.en: : It’s always impressive how you’re able to both strong-arm me and flirt at the same time.
lines.zh: : 你总能一边对我强势一边撩我，真是令人佩服。

lines.en: scene yukiwater7

: Aight, first and foremost — I don’t {i}strong-arm{/i} you into anything. And, if I do, it ain’t intentional. Probably just a result of me being a badass or some shit. But second, this ain’t flirting.
lines.zh: : 行，首先——我才没有{i}强势逼{/i}你做任何事。就算有，也不是故意的。大概只是因为我太牛逼什么的。不过其次，这不是在撩。

lines.en: : How would you know? You’ve never been in a real relationship before.
lines.zh: : 你怎么知道？你又没谈过真正的恋爱。

lines.en: : Have {i}you?{/i} Because it seems to me like you’re just the town bimbo a lot of the time.
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}谈过？在我看来，你很多时候就是镇上的荡妇。

lines.en: scene yukiwater8
: That’s not far off, but...
lines.zh: : 这话也不算离谱，不过……

lines.en: : I have.
lines.zh: : 我谈过。

lines.en: : Oh? Then maybe you {i}do{/i} know what you’re talkin’ about. But still, we’re two different weight classes. And I ain’t about to go punchin’ at someone so much weaker than me.
lines.zh: : 哦？那也许你{i}确实{/i}知道自己在说什么。不过话说回来，我们俩重量级不同。我也不会去揍一个比我弱那么多的人。

lines.en: : That’s fair. And I was just kidding in the first place. You’ve been surprisingly kind to me for someone who could kick my ass at any moment.
lines.zh: : 公平。而且我一开始只是开玩笑。对于一个随时能把我揍得半死的人来说，你对我意外地友善。

lines.en: : Thank you for admitting that.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你承认这一点。

lines.en: : And thank you for not eating me.
lines.zh: : 也谢谢你没有吃掉我。

lines.en: scene yukiwater9
: For {i}what?{/i}
lines.zh: : 为{i}什么{/i}这么说？

lines.en: : When you were outside of Kumon-mi, what was it like?
lines.zh: : 你在 Kumon-mi 之外的时候，那是什么样的？

lines.en: : What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 什么意思？

lines.en: : Like...you’ve been in this city long enough to understand how it feels, right? How no one comes in and no one goes out.
lines.zh: : 就是……你在这座城市待得够久了，应该明白那种感觉吧？没人进来，也没人出去。

lines.en: : That ain’t entirely true. Had a whole ass group of European dudes come into the bar the other night and I had to kick ‘em out since I’m the only one of us who knew any English.
lines.zh: : 也不全是这样。前几天晚上有一整帮欧洲佬进了酒吧，我不得不把他们赶出去，因为我们是唯一一个懂点英语的。

lines.en: scene yukiwater10
: You know English?
lines.zh: : 你懂英语？

lines.en: : Just the basic shit. “Hello. How are you doing? Where is the restroom?” Shit like that.
lines.zh: : 就是些基本的。「你好。你好吗？洗手间在哪儿？」之类的。

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Picked it up from an old friend. One of those creative types, like you.
lines.zh: : 跟一个老朋友学的。那种创作型的，跟你一样。

lines.en: : Someone in your gang?
lines.zh: : 你帮派里的人？

lines.en: scene yukiwater11
: Something like that. But yeah, wound up havin’ to kick ‘em out since Sana and Sara were too embarrassed to even try.
lines.zh: : 差不多吧。不过是啊，最后只好把他们赶出去，因为 Sana 和 Sara 连试都不好意思试。

lines.en: scene yukiwater12
: Why do you think it’d be any different outside of here, though? You ain’t thinkin’ of hoppin’ the wall, are you?
lines.zh: : 不过你凭什么觉得外面就会不一样？你该不会在想着翻墙吧？

lines.en: : Is that even possible?
lines.zh: : 那甚至可能吗？

lines.en: : Not with that attitude it ain’t. Moment you doubt yourself is the moment you fall several hundred feet and turn into a fuckin’ Sensei puddle.
lines.zh: : 抱着这种态度就不可能。你怀疑自己的那一刻，就是你坠下几百英尺、变成一滩操蛋的 Sensei 泥的那一刻。

lines.en: scene yukiwater13
: Fair enough.
lines.zh: : 说得也是。

lines.en: : I’ve just been wondering a lot lately about what it would be like to sort of...start over. But I feel like, as long as I’m here, that’ll never be possible.
lines.zh: : 我最近只是经常在想，如果……重新开始会是什么样。可我觉得，只要我还待在这儿，那就不可能。

lines.en: : There’s too much tying me to this place. Too many things I’d rather just forget at this point because they make just getting through each day way harder than it should ever be.
lines.zh: : 把这地方拴住我的东西太多了。有太多事我宁愿就此忘掉，因为它们让每天撑过去变得比本该有的样子难得多。

lines.en: scene yukiwater14
: Mm.

: Well, sorry to burst your bubble, but that shit’ll follow you even if you {i}do{/i} manage to make it out of here, man. Just changin’ scenery ain’t enough to “start over.” I know that better than anybody.
lines.zh: : 那个，抱歉要戳破你的美梦了，不过就算你{i}真{/i}能离开这儿，那堆破事也会跟着你，老兄。光换个风景不足以「重新开始」。这点我比谁都清楚。

lines.en: : Like yeah, a new town might be exciting for a little while. You might be able to distract yourself from all that shit you’d “rather forget.” But the second you start to remember, you’ll have to move {i}again.{/i}
lines.zh: : 是啊，新镇子也许能让你兴奋一阵子。你也许能靠着那些新鲜事，不去想你「宁愿忘掉」的破事。可一旦你开始想起来，你就得{i}再{/i}搬一次。

lines.en: : So you’ll move and you’ll move and you’ll move, but you’ll never get any further away from the shit you’re trying to escape from. And, soon enough, all those places will start to blur together.
lines.zh: : 于是你搬啊搬啊搬，却永远无法离你想逃离的东西更远一点。而不久之后，那些地方就会开始模糊成一片。

lines.en: : That’s sort of where I’m at. How there’s no “one town” that sticks out to me from my past because, if there was, I’d still {i}be{/i} there.
lines.zh: : 我大概就处在这个状态。所以我的过去里没有什么「某一个镇子」能让我记起来——因为如果有，我大概还{i}待在{/i}那儿。

lines.en: scene yukiwater15
: Nobody can escape the past, man. All you can do is confront it. And hey, maybe you get your ass beat. Maybe you don’t.
lines.zh: : 没人能逃过过去，老兄。你能做的只有面对它。而且嘿，也许你会被揍个半死。也许不会。

lines.en: : But there’s a lot more honor in goin’ down with a fight than just lying down and letting life kick the shit out of you.
lines.zh: : 但带着战斗倒下，总比躺下来任由生活把你揍个稀烂要有尊严得多。

lines.en: : That may be true. But what good does something vague like “honor” do in the first place?
lines.zh: : 也许是吧。可像「尊严」这么含糊的东西，到底有什么用？

lines.en: : What good does being a bitch do?
lines.zh: : 当个孬种又有什么用？

lines.en: : Nothing really.
lines.zh: : 确实没什么用。

lines.en: : Exactly. Cause nothing matters at all when shit really comes down to it.
lines.zh: : 正是。因为真到了紧要关头，什么他妈都不重要。

lines.en: : It’s up to {i}us{/i} to figure out what we value. And honor’s kinda fuckin’ bred into us since our ancestors were probably samurai or some shit.
lines.zh: : 什么值得看重，得由{i}我们自己{/i}决定。而尊严这东西，大概是从我们祖上是武士还是什么的时候起就他妈刻进我们骨子里的。

lines.en: : If that doesn’t mean anything to you, then fuck it. But to me, honor and respect are, like...all I’ve got. Especially now that I’ve got a kid who might look back at me like you’re lookin’ at {i}your{/i} past some day.
lines.zh: : 如果那对你毫无意义，那就随它去。可对我来说，尊严和尊重，是……我仅有的一切。尤其是现在我有了一个孩子，而她有一天也许会像你现在看{i}自己的{/i}过去那样回看我。

lines.en: : I don’t wanna be something she’s gotta run from, you know? And the best way of doin’ that is by not settin’ an example and running away myself.
lines.zh: : 我不想成为她必须逃离的东西，你懂吧？而做到这一点最好的办法，就是别以身作则地自己先跑。

lines.en: : You...You {i}did,{/i} though. You {i}did{/i} run.
lines.zh: : 你……可你{i}跑了{/i}。你{i}确实{/i}跑了。

lines.en: scene yukiwater16
: Yeah, and look how {i}that{/i} worked out. Shit didn’t change until I {i}stopped.{/i} So maybe it’ll be the same for you.
lines.zh: : 是啊，看看{i}结果{/i}如何。直到我{i}停下来{/i}，事情才改变。所以也许对你来说也是一样的。

lines.en: scene yukiwater17
: I hate talking to you. You’re always wiser than I expect and none of my counterpoints ever last more than a second.
lines.zh: : 我讨厌跟你说话。你总是比我预想的睿智，而我的反驳从来撑不过一秒。

lines.en: : Well, maybe {i}you’ll{/i} be as wise as me in another decade or so. And this ain’t me sayin’ I’ve been through more since I don’t really know what your deal is yet, but...
lines.zh: : 嗯，也许再过十年左右{i}你{/i}就能跟我一样睿智了。这不是说我经历得比你多，毕竟我还不清楚你到底是什么情况，不过……

lines.en: : It’s clear you’ve been through a lot. And it’s that kinda shit that makes people call us “wise” when we’re wastin’ away our morning getting drunk by the river.
lines.zh: : 很明显你经历了不少。而正是那种事，让我们这种在河边借酒消磨早晨的人被称为「睿智」。

lines.en: scene yukiwater18
: Thank you, Yuki.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Yuki。

lines.en: : Hm? For what? Givin’ you advice even though you never asked for it?
lines.zh: : 嗯？谢什么？谢你没开口问我就给了你一堆建议？

lines.en: : Everything, really.
lines.zh: : 真的，是全部。

lines.en: : I’m glad you never gave up because that means I get to spend time with you now.
lines.zh: : 我很高兴你没有放弃，因为那意味着我现在能和你待在一起。

lines.en: scene yukiwater19
: Wha-
: Ain’t...{i}you{/i} just flirting now? Didn’t you just give me shit a few minutes ago after accusin’ me of the same damn thing?
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}这不是……在撩我吗？几分钟前你还因为我说同样的话而损我来着？

lines.en: : I wasn’t giving you shit. I was just trying to mold another conversation into a shape that wouldn’t force me to accept something I’m already beginning to understand.
lines.zh: : 我没有损你。我只是想把另一段对话捏成一个形状，好让我不必去接受一件我已经开始明白的事。

lines.en: scene yukiwater20
: Well...I’ve got no fuckin’ clue what you mean by that, but...be careful about what you say and shit.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我他妈完全不知道你什么意思，不过……说话注意点什么的。

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Because I said so, okay?
lines.zh: : 因为我说了算，行吗？

lines.en: : Is just admitting that I enjoy spending time with you really enough to make you this bashful? Is that seriously your only weakness?
lines.zh: : 光是承认我喜欢和你待在一起，就足以让你这么害羞吗？这真的是你唯一的弱点？

lines.en: scene yukiwater21
: Okay. Listen up, douchebag. Ain’t nobody ever actually shown me that sorta {i}kindness{/i} before. So sorry if I’m reacting weirdly to it after fuckin’ decades without any experience at all.
lines.zh: : 行。听好了，混蛋。以前真的从来没有人对我表示过那种{i}善意{/i}。所以抱歉，在他妈几十年毫无经验之后，我的反应有点怪。

lines.en: : Why are you apologizing? I like this side of you.
lines.zh: : 你道什么歉？我喜欢你这一面。

lines.en: scene yukiwater22
: Jesus, fuck! Stop!
lines.zh: : 操，耶稣！够了！

lines.en: : I might be your senior, but I’m still a fuckin’ girl, you know? And between this and all that shit about callin’ me cute a while ago, you’re gonna fuckin’...confuse me or something.
lines.zh: : 我也许是你的长辈，可我还是个他妈的女孩，你懂吗？再加上之前那些说我可爱之类的破事，你会他妈的……把我搞糊涂什么的。

lines.en: : I wish everyone reacted to honesty this way. It would make my life a hell of a lot easier.
lines.zh: : 我真希望每个人都能这样回应诚实。那会让我的生活轻松得多。

lines.en: scene yukiwater23
: Yeah, well...all it does is make mine harder.
lines.zh: : 是嘛，那个……这只会让我的生活更难。

lines.en: : How so?
lines.zh: : 怎么讲？

lines.en: : Yuki?
lines.zh: : Yuki？

lines.en: : I wonder how you would’ve felt about me if we met when we were younger. Like...teenagers or some shit.
lines.zh: : 我在想，要是我们年轻的时候就认识，你会怎么看我。比如……都是十几岁什么的。

lines.en: : You’re almost ten years older than me, aren’t you? I can’t imagine you’d have had any interest in me back then.
lines.zh: : 你比我大快十岁吧？我无法想象你当年会对我有兴趣。

lines.en: : I meant more, like...it’d be cool if we were the same age back then. Just wanna know how you’d feel about the old me rather than the burnout you’re wastin’ your time on now.
lines.zh: : 我更多是指……如果那时候我们同岁就好了。只是想知道你会怎么看当年那个我，而不是现在这个你在浪费时间的废人。

lines.en: : I doubt we would have meshed well, to be honest.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我怀疑我们合不来。

lines.en: : Yeah, you’re probably right.
lines.zh: : 是啊，你大概是对的。

lines.en: : We’re practically opposites even now, aren’t we?
lines.zh: : 就算现在，我们也几乎是完全相反的人，不是吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, but...is that really a bad thing?
lines.zh: : 是啊，不过……那真的是坏事吗？

lines.en: : It ain’t bad, but...it ain’t really {i}good{/i} either. Not sure if we’ll ever, like...see eye-to-eye on anything.
lines.zh: : 不算坏，不过……也算不上{i}好{/i}。不确定我们会不会……在某些事上看法一致。

lines.en: : That’ll just keep our talks interesting then.
lines.zh: : 那只会让我们的谈话一直有意思。

lines.en: : Well...I’m gonna-
lines.zh: : 那个……我要——

lines.en: : Listen...uh...{i}Sensei...{/i}
lines.zh: : 听我说……呃……{i}Sensei{/i}……

lines.en: : If you, like...
lines.zh: : 如果你，那个……

lines.en: : If you’re actually...like...
lines.zh: : 如果你真的……那个……

lines.en: : If you actually think I’m...you know...{i}cute{/i} or whatever...
lines.zh: : 如果你真的觉得我……你知道的……{i}可爱{/i}还是什么的……

lines.en: : Could you, like...not say that anymore?
lines.zh: : 你能不能……别再那么说了？

lines.en: : Sara’s my boss, but like...she’s also a friend and shit. And she’s crazy about you whether you like that or not, so...I ain’t about to go, like...makin’ that more complicated, if you know what I mean.
lines.zh: : Sara 是我老板，不过，那个……她也是朋友什么的。而且不管你乐意不乐意，她都为你疯狂，所以我不会去……把事情弄得更复杂，如果你懂我意思的话。

lines.en: : This is all just...assumin’ you ain’t bullshittin’ me, though. Cause I ain’t really got any idea...
lines.zh: : 当然，这一切都只是……假设你不是在跟我放屁。因为我真的什么都不知道……

lines.en: : Do you actually like me, Yuki?
lines.zh: : 你真的喜欢我吗，Yuki？

lines.en: : Fuck if I know, man. All I know is that this blows and I keep wishin’ the fuckin’ circumstances were different. Cause I feel like Yumi’d be pissed about this too and I ain’t about to ruin shit {i}again{/i} with her.
lines.zh: : 操，我上哪儿知道去，老兄。我只知道这烂透了，而我一直在希望操蛋的情况能不一样。因为我觉得 Yumi 也会为这个生气，而我不想{i}再{/i}跟她把事情搞砸。

lines.en: : Yeah...
lines.zh: : 是啊……

lines.en: : I wouldn’t want to do that to you either.
lines.zh: : 我也不想对你做那种事。

lines.en: scene black
: I’m gonna walk around for a little while. But I’ll see you around the campsite.
lines.zh: : 我打算四处走走。不过我们在营地再见。

lines.en: : Thanks for the beer. And also the advice.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你的啤酒。还有那些建议。

lines.en: : And also for existing.
lines.zh: : 也谢谢你还活着。

lines.en: : Just...get lost, man. You’re interrupting my alone time.
lines.zh: : 就……滚吧，老兄。你打扰我独处了。

lines.en: scene sky
I leave Yuki by the riverside with all the same decaying parts and pieces she had when I first showed up.
lines.zh: 我离开河边的 Yuki，她身上带着的，还是我来时那副衰败的零件与碎片。

lines.en: But, for a brief moment in time, I imagine how much better they’d have tasted if we could turn back the clocks.
lines.zh: 不过，有那么短暂的一瞬，我想象着——如果我们能把时钟拨回去，它们尝起来会好上多少。

lines.en: They’re all without hands now.
lines.zh: 它们现在全都没有指针了。

lines.en: They’re just like dinner.
lines.zh: 它们就像晚餐一样。

$ yuki_love += 1
{i}Yuki’s affection has increased to [yuki_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Yuki 的好感度提升到了 [yuki_love]!{/i}

lines.zh: 我现在该做什么？
